quest.title: Search Chronicle: Burning Up!
quest.description: You receive a very strange commission. Go to the area around the Pyro Regisvine to learn more from the client.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x15, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: Ah, you're finally here. You're the "protagonist," yes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon's not sure what you mean by that question...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Ah, would you look at that? Too eager for my own good again — and they even told me to be concise when I was posting the commission, too.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Here's the low-down. I'm Ranjit, a chef of cuisines creative. I've been looking to get along nicely with a Pyro Regisvine, but it seems uninterested in my company...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Spitting fireballs and slamming the ground... Nothing I could do about that, so I'm hiring some adventurer help — of the protagonist kind, to be exact.

choices.text: No problem! Just leave it to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, hey! Don't go around agreeing to take on such ridiculous commissions!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, are you for real? A creative cuisine chef, making friends with a Pyro Regisvine... Nothing about this makes any sense!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Really? I mean, it is a very grumpy plant, but you never know till you try, right?

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: And after the Regisvine, I'd also like to give the Primo Geovishap, Jadeplume Terrorshroom, and Millennial Pearl Seahorse a go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...This is getting crazier by the minute. Where did you even get these ideas from?

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Actually, it's because of my trip to Natlan not long ago...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: It's a truly amazing place. If I had to describe its marvelous novelty, it would be like the first time I ate curry spicy enough to make me rain sweat.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: My tongue had taken all the stimulation it could bear, but I shoveled spoonful after spoonful into my mouth. I couldn't help myself!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: ...Speaking of which, I met a whole bunch of friends in Natlan. They're all good folks. Some taught me rock climbing, and others introduced me to the hot springs.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Bet you didn't know this, but the people of Natlan, especially their warriors, dress in imitation of their Saurians — and when in full panoply, they look every bit as brave!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: I made myself a hat based on those of my Natlan friends. Pretty awesome, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Sure, it is pretty unique, but Paimon can't quite tell what you're talking about just from that.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: True, true! I mean, I haven't got a Saurian buddy with me, do I?

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: *sigh* It sure would be nice if I did, though. But I'm not a local, and to be honest, I'd get restless staying there for too long.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: That's why I thought to get myself a companion outside Natlan that could take the spot of a Saurian. Even if that doesn't work, it'll make a great story to tell my Natlan friends!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, if that's your goal, you could've picked more suitable targets to make friends with, right?

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Huh? Don't you find them suitable? I mean, they're even like the Natlan Saurians — and they're also strong, to boot!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: A Sumpter Beast companion's really nothing to brag about. I'll need a more demanding trial if I want a tale worth telling!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: The real pity is that I can't be the "protagonist" myself... Calming these beasts that rage day and night is no easy task, let me tell you!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: But I suppose that's your field of expertise as an experienced adventurer, right? Of course, I'll provide support from the sidelines. Nets, food... You name it, you can leave it to me!

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: But as for our "negotiations" with our prospective partners... The spotlight's going to be on you, dear "protagonist"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you foisting the dangerous stuff onto your protagonist?

choices.text: The pay had better be worth the work...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Of course, of course! Sure thing.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Well, since we're agreed, shall we head out now? My pots are ready, and my equipment's all checked. We should be good to go!

choices.text: I've got other things to handle. See you in a bit.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: No worries. I'll wait for you here.

choices.text: I'm sure we can come to an agreement — if you convince me.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Of course, that's how these things work.

choices.text: I don't understand what you're talking about...
